rows.label: tlk70000002_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Most of the goods outside Obibi's shop
burned up, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000002_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Our products weren't popular with
Nopon, but Chamber of Commerce
artisans liked them, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000002_02_msg0003
rows.name:
When I think of those people, I feel
awfully sorry, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000002_02_msg0004
rows.name:
But Obibi doesn't have the energy to
start over from nothing anymore, mo...

rows.label: tlk70000002_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Mo? Obibi was naked to begin with, mo?
Th-that kind of comeback doesn't
matter, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000002_02_msg0006
rows.name:
That's it, mo! The goods in the
warehouse should still be safe, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000002_02_msg0007
rows.name:
Obibi will try just a little longer,
mo!
